Stableford: cada hoyo da puntos según tu: Stableford: each hole gives points from your net score (shots minus those your handicap gives you on that hole): 2 for a net par, 3 for a net birdie, 4 for a net eagle, 1 for a net bogey and 0 if you take more. Whoever scores most points wins.
Medal neto: cuentan todos los golpes de: Net Medal: all the shots of the round count, minus your handicap. The leaderboard is net against the par of the holes played (−2 is two under net par). Whoever has fewest wins.
Match play: hoyo a hoyo. Con dos jugador: Match play: hole by hole. With two players it's the usual head-to-head; with more, everyone against everyone (round robin): each pair plays its own match and gets 1 point for a match won and half for a draw. In each match, the player with the higher handicap receives the difference on the hardest holes.
